correctness.rationale: A length-two PAL duplication of ab inserts ba after ab, and every second operation is allowed to overlap newly inserted symbols. The two-step descendant confusability graph is exact by direct set intersection. I fetched the actual source certificate.json and independently regenerated descendant sets for every binary word of each length n=2,...,8 with a fresh JavaScript implementation. For EACH n, the stored size-M witness consisted of pairwise nonconfusable words and the stored M conflict cliques partitioned all 2^n source words, with pairwise confusability in every clique. Both directions independently passed for M=4,8,14,20,28,42,66; hence this is an exact matching independence-number lower and upper certificate, not a solver log. Current full primary paper establishes exact-two/at-most-two equivalence and even-length PAL/RC conjugacy, permitting the same values for RC2.
residual_risks: This establishes seven finite lengths only. The file RESULT.md in the source contains control-character corruption in two display-math commands; numeric certificates and final scientific statement remain unambiguous.
